text:
sam: Found a pretty bad combination in examples/telemetry-js: JS SDK logs raw prompts at INFO and OTEL spans lack a `redwood.request_id`. Repro steps and log below.
julia: ouch. paste the log line?
sam: `INFO 2026-06-02T14:05:17Z route=/complete prompt=\"My secret plan\" request_id=- sdk=telemetry-js`
omar: hyphen means no request_id injected by transport. OTEL hook should set span attr from that id.
julia: I checked src/transport/fetcher.js: reqId generation moved there but logger gets defaultMeta earlier so it never sees it. Also redaction only applied for ERROR in src/logger.js.
qa: screenshot of failing test in CI: logs show clear prompts when REDACT_PROMPT=true.
sam: quick patch idea: add a preformat filter to logger so redaction runs before any formatter, e.g.
```js
logger.addFilter(record => {
  if (process.env.REDACT_PROMPT === 'true') {
    record.message = record.message.replace(/prompt=\"[^\"]*\"/g, 'prompt=\"[REDACTED]\"')
  }
  return true
})
```
omar: and for OTEL: after transport computes reqId do: `const span = api.trace.getSpan(context.active()); if (span) span.setAttribute('redwood.request_id', reqId)` so traces and logs can be correlated.
julia: add a tiny e2e in examples/telemetry-js: run sample with REDACT_PROMPT=true and fail if stdout matches prompt regex. CI-friendly and catches regressions.
infra-bot: Created internal issue #2987: "js-sdk: propagate request_id to logger & OTEL; redact prompts at all levels" <https://redwood.internal/issue/2987> :white_check_mark:
qa: I'll add unit tests asserting redaction for DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR. Regex check is fine.
sam: I'll open a draft PR with: transport exposes reqId via context, logger picks up reqId into defaultMeta, otel-hook attaches attribute, and logger prefilter respects REDACT_PROMPT. Will include before/after logs in PR.
omar: please also add docs/devex/telemetry.md snippet for `x-request-id` conventions and the example filter.
julia: pairing later today if anyone wants help with the OTEL bits. :eyes:
sam: ping me on PR when ready, I'll review perf and make sure filter is cheap.
